title: From question to approved SQL

nodes.label: React app
nodes.note: Vite and TypeScript chat UI with Zustand and TanStack Query. Shows stage progress, SQL review and approval, results tables and Recharts charts.

nodes.label: FastAPI app
nodes.note: /v1 routers for query, schema, sessions, glossary, business docs, webhooks and team. Middleware for request ID, size limits, security headers, idempotency keys, rate limits.

nodes.label: Auth and API keys
nodes.note: Self-hosted JWT auth (bcrypt, HS256, issuer and audience checked) plus API-key authentication. Sets the tenant used for row-level security.

nodes.label: ARQ worker
nodes.note: app/jobs/worker.py. Embedding jobs, schema sync, business-doc chunking, webhook delivery with a dead-letter retry job, plus cron for nightly schema diffs and daily usage.

nodes.label: 1. Classify
nodes.note: stage1_classifier.py. Blocklist and prompt-injection checks with no LLM cost, then LLM intent classification and follow-up detection.

nodes.label: 2. Retrieve
nodes.note: stage2_retriever.py. One question embedding reused for parallel, tenant-scoped searches of four Qdrant collections.

nodes.label: 3. Select schema
nodes.note: stage3_selector.py. A fast-tier LLM call prunes the schema to the needed tables and columns, then builds the generation prompt.

nodes.label: 4. Generate SQL
nodes.note: stage4_generator.py. Generation-tier LLM, 5-step static validation, up to 3 retries with the error fed back, and a confidence score.

nodes.label: 5. Approval and execute
nodes.note: stage5_executor.py and connection/executor.py. Risk tier, approved_by required, LIMIT injected, run in BEGIN READ ONLY with a timeout.

nodes.label: Platform Postgres
nodes.note: asyncpg with Alembic migrations: workspaces, members, connections, schema snapshots, audit log, chat sessions, API keys, webhooks. Row-level security by tenant.

nodes.label: Qdrant
nodes.note: Four collections: schema_docs, glossary_embeddings, query_pairs_embeddings and business_document_chunks.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.note: Chat session context (2-hour TTL), sliding-window rate limits, idempotency-key responses (24 hours) and the ARQ job queue.

nodes.label: MinIO object store
nodes.note: S3-compatible bucket, accessed with aioboto3, that holds uploaded business documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD).

nodes.label: LLM providers
nodes.note: Two tiers, fast and generation, over any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. llm_router.py fails over between providers with a circuit breaker.

nodes.label: Embedding API
nodes.note: OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint, such as a local Ollama model, used for questions, schema docs, glossary and document chunks.

nodes.label: Sentry and Langfuse
nodes.note: Errors go to Sentry and pipeline spans to Langfuse, both initialised at startup in app/main.py.

nodes.label: Customer webhooks
nodes.note: Outbound events signed with an HMAC by webhooks_outbound.py and delivered with retries by the worker.

nodes.label: Customer database
nodes.note: The tenant's own database, reached through a per-tenant asyncpg pool, optionally via an SSH bastion tunnel. Credentials are stored encrypted.

flow: The browser posts a question to the streaming generate endpoint and the API checks the plan's query limit.
Stage 1 runs the blocklist and injection checks, then classifies intent, and may stop to ask a clarifying question.
Stage 2 embeds the question once and searches four tenant-scoped Qdrant collections in parallel.
Stage 3 prunes the schema with a fast model and builds the prompt; each stage is streamed to the browser as an SSE event.
Stage 4 generates SQL, validates it with sqlglot and a blocklist, and retries with the error and a higher temperature if it fails.
The user reviews the SQL and risk tier and approves; the executor runs it in a read-only transaction on the customer's database.
Secondary path: uploading a business document stores it in MinIO, and an ARQ job extracts, chunks, embeds and writes it to Qdrant.
Secondary path: nightly cron jobs re-introspect each tenant's schema and diff it, and webhook events are delivered with retries.
